svg.aria-label: UML class diagram of the crawler's scraper: the scrapeCompanyVacancies half of CompanyCrawler. CrawlerRunnerService holds a map of CompanyCrawler beans and a CrawlingProgressService. DefaultCompanyCrawler realizes CompanyCrawler and implements scrapeCompanyVacancies over the abstract configurePageScrapeSettings and the configurePageScraper and configureMetadataCrawler hooks. It uses a CompanyMetadataCrawler, NoCallMetadataCrawler by default, and creates StaticPageScraper by default. StaticPageScraper, NoCallPageScraper and DynamicPageScraper realize PageScraper; DynamicPageScraper holds a BrowserPool. The models package holds ScrapeSettings, MetadataParams and PageScraperResponse. MetadataScrapeException, MetadataParseException, VacancyPageScrapeException and UnresolvedPlaceholderException extend RuntimeException.
